newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania sees slight rise in 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Eridania sees slight rise in 1997 profit.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say Chairman Stefano Meloni said he expected the food group to show a slight rise in its operating and net profits for 1997 and increase the dividend.

"I think a small improvement in our operating results is possible for 1997 and consequently, I hope our net profit will also improve, and at that point, we could envisage an increase in the dividend," he told the shareholders meeting.
Eridania reported net attributable profit of 1.66 billion francs for 1996, up from 1.53 billion, and paid a dividend of 33 francs, unchanged from 1995.
